title: [Lean] Connect complete-bank endpoints to PR516 realization
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
One new theorem, `CurrentMain.PR516CompleteBankEndpoint.full_state_endpoint`, connects the full physical helper/rest endpoint from #516 to the sequential completed-bank interface in #513. It directly reuses `LemmaA.family_endpoint`, `LemmaA.endpoint_indep`, #509's event semantics and Mathlib's `Equiv.funSplitAt`; it does not reprove their inductions.

Author-checked conditional source context:
- main/base: `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`
- κ = `90446448750933/125000000000000000 = 0.000723571590007464`
- This is the unchanged selected construction context, not a new exponent saving derived by this adapter.

## Coverage
- Finite: no new selected finite witness, census, matrix computation or numerical instance checker is claimed.
- Conditional interface: for arbitrary initial helper and rest values, the completed word gives the specified helper operator and rest output independent of the initial helper. Full unit row and zero off-diagonal helper column are separate hypotheses. The reference zero in the rest definition imposes no clean-state assumption.
- Full theorem: actual physical execution, injective owners, exact recipes, well-labelled events, full rows/columns including the work register, common-chart partial swap, all-60-replica partition/order, boundaries and physical costs remain explicit. No full multiplication/runtime theorem is proved.

## Reuse and exact pins
- #516: `1c6b6ff9366a94e1f86a6c5d661a7df75c6ff814`, Realize only, with a reversible import alias and explicit modification notice.
- #509: `7b9c720ecc9f483c383e7cd9c2ab81f06ee5df59`, Stream bytes unchanged.
- #513: `005dd3f4e3cba8d1761abc4ab391aaf6d14d6f73`, six support sources unchanged.
- Lean 4.21.0; Mathlib `308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3`.
DreamingOfClouds and predecessor authors retain attribution and Apache-2.0 notices. PR516's numerical/window checkers are outside this closure, including the fixed-layout checker discussed in its latest comment.

Existing #509/#513/#516 were compared before publication; generic realization is credited upstream. The new contribution is the complete pair-valued interface adapter. No superseded PR is closed.

## Validation and reproduction
Fresh isolated nine-source package replay passed: 70 complete axiom probes, each using only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; 19.3728 compiler seconds, 0.00412 FIFO seconds, 3,301,359,616 bytes peak VM. Eight object hashes match the research check; the notice-modified Realize object is separately recorded. Twenty changed files, all under `research/lean-complete-bank-endpoint`; no root or scientific CI changes.

Offline command (with existing exact source worktrees and built pinned runtime):
```sh
python3 research/lean-complete-bank-endpoint/check.py --lean /path/to/lean-4.21.0-linux/bin/lean --mathlib-root /path/to/mathlib4 --pr509-root /path/to/PR509/research/e8-lemma-g-lean --pr516-root /path/to/PR516/research/e8-lemma-a-lean --pr513-root /path/to/PR513/research/lean-sequential-bank-bindings --build-dir /path/to/new-empty-reproduction-directory
```
Exact hashes, full receipts, resources and replay boundaries are packaged. Local kernel results are separate from fork/upstream CI, which has not been reported as passed. The inherited joint-certificate root-file provenance issue is outside this chunk.

Prepared by James Chang with OpenAI dot and GPT Astra assistance; upstream assistance disclosures are preserved.
